outcome: fetal growth biometrics (abdominal circumference [AC], head circumference [HC], femur length [FL])
fetal growth biometrics z score changes
cohort: The study included 369 women with a singleton live birth, enrolled in a hospital-based prospective preconception cohort.
finding: Maternal preconception generalised retinal arteriolar narrowing was consistently associated with a reduction in fetal abdominal circumference z scores throughout pregnancy and significantly reduced z score changes in abdominal circumference and femur length between 24-28 weeks and 32-34 weeks of gestation.
